sentences.text: Sukumar Mondal & Ors vs Unknown on 13 February, 2024

Bench: Debangsu Basak  C.R.M. (A) 498 of 2024 13.02.2024 DL-93 Court No.29 In Re: - An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of (AD) the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with (Allowed) Raghunathganj Police Station Case No. 04 of 2023 dated 02.01.2023 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code,1860.
Charge sheet No.277 of 2023 dated 01.04.2023 (G.R. No.09 of 2023).

And In the matter of: Sukumar Mondal & Ors.
....petitioners.

Mr. Sanjoy Bardhan Ms. Jonaki Saha ...for the State.
Police filed charge sheet.
Husband was granted bail by the jurisdictional Court.
Petitioners before us are the in-laws of the victim.
Consequently, we grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a Bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each, with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default, the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioners in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
The prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed. C.R.M. (A) 498 of 2024 is disposed of.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
